query:
SELECT
                COUNT(CASE WHEN timestamp >= $2 THEN 1 END) as proofs_24h,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN timestamp >= $3 THEN 1 END) as proofs_7d,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN timestamp >= $4 THEN 1 END) as proofs_30d
            FROM worker_events
            WHERE public_key = $1
                AND topic = $5
                AND status = 'COMPLETED'
